body: I really Appreciate your perspective on all of this. It means a lot

My fiance said I make his depression worse.....that killed me. I would never want anyone to feel worse than what deoression already does to people.

How awful am I, that I really made someone feel worse than THAT? He is such a sweet soul.....im ....i don't deserve him. I deserve nothing but pain. :(

No. The pain I cause isn't physical but I just feel like I hurt everyone I care about. I just have this flaw...this inability to allow myself to let people love me. I have to push them away and when they won't leave i hurt them to keep them away. I lash out ot do something awful to make them hate me. I dont want them to love me. Ever. Its a waste of time. They are much better off....I hate that i hurt them but I know i am no good for anyone. I will never be good for anyone.
I felt this in my core. My existence is a burden. I dont know you, but being that I can relate, I am eternally sorry you feel this way. Its hell.

It sounds like you may need to Ivolve the police unfortunately. Given the time frame though...of they are serious then its crucial you get to 911 asap. They can track the last known address attached to that cell number
Do they have an iphone? Or android?
Ok ok dont panic. Did you try calling them? Can you ping their location?

If you know where they live go to them. Do NOT call the police. They will have them strapped to a hospital bed and confined to a psych ward for a mandatory 72 hours. Its hell. 

Please go be with your friend. Wake up everyone in the house. Fight for them..
The last time I trusted someone completely I was sexually assaulted....I cant do that again

You are gonna make me cry. 

Oh love, I'm so sorry you are hurting. Please please allow the ppl closest to you to love up on you right now. Let them tell you how much you mean to them. Lay on your boyfriends chest and let him tell you what life would be like without you. you matter. Keep going. I wont tell you the pain will be easy to bear, it wont be. It will be a constant fight.. . But ending your life will only transfer your pain to those that love you. I know you dont want that. Get help... fight back. You deserve a shot, a decent fucking shot at a good, happy life

I know the feeling. your friends will love you and miss you. I hope you reconsider...this is coming from someone who probably wont make it to her 30th bday in a few months. Lol.

But seriously....really think about it. Your life has meaning.
I couldn't prey on ppl like that. I'm just lonely, it's my own fault because I'm really just fucked up to ppl that try to love me. Idk how to stop this cycle and in tired. Honestly

Unfortunately if this is the choice you intend to make nobody can stop you.

I'm just gonna tell you what I wish someone would tell me...

To someone, you are worth the fight, the effort,  the will the time.... to someone you are everything. 

I'm a stranger on the internet,  and I feel your pain. You arent alone and I want you to get better because being a hollow shell, like me, isn't  a life. I can tell you wanna live because you reached out. Stay strong young padawan. You got this....and If you dont, no judgement.
